title: Lemma 3 in Placeholder and Fictive (2023)
headline: A step in the proof of Lemma 3 needs an extra condition (a repairable proof gap). Theorem 1 is not refuted. An erratum was published after the authors were notified.

work.title: Optimal Base-Stock Policies under Lost Sales with Random Yield

claims.label: Lemma 3
claims.statement: The expected one-period cost is convex in the order-up-to level for every yield distribution with finite mean.
claims.quantifiers: for every yield distribution with finite mean

result.witness: The interchange of differentiation and expectation in the proof needs a bounded density, which the lemma does not assume. A two-point yield distribution shows the step fails.
result.repair_note: Adding a bounded-density assumption restores the step; the conclusion holds in all cases checked.
not_claimed: Theorem 1 (optimality of base-stock policies) is not refuted.
The convexity conclusion is not claimed to be false; only the proof step is incomplete.
